> [!IMPORTANT]
> Title must follow the conventional commit format (<type>(<scope>): <description>).
> It becomes the squash commit message when the PR is merged. The scope is optional, but recommended.

## Description

Provide a concise description of the changes.

## Related issues

Link related issues (e.g. `Fixes #123`, `Closes #456`).

## Checklist

* [ ] Includes new tests, that tests the feature or fix.
* [ ] Includes at least two users stories in the documentation (if applicable).
* [ ] Updates the documentation accordingly. (if applicable)
